paragraphs.text: Senior Software Engineer with 10+ years of expertise using modern web development technologies. Proven ability
to build accessible and user-friendly interfaces, collaborate effectively within teams, and deliver high-quality code.
Seeking software engineering roles at any level.
Frontend & UX: React, TypeScript, Next.js, Storybook, CSS/SCSS, Design systems, Localisation
Backend & APIs: Node.js, .NET, Ruby on Rails, Python Flask,  GraphQL, REST/JSON:API, Schema design
DevOps & Tooling: AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions, CircleCI, Cypress, Jest/React Testing Library (RTL), Monitoring
Leadership & Accessibility: Technical mentoring, Stakeholder facilitation, Accessibility advocacy,
Senior Software Engineer | Numeral Studio | Wellington, NZ
2025 – Present
Delivered reusable React/TypeScript components inside Electron with accessible, responsive UI patterns plus
Supported the launch of the design conference 2025 and 2026 site on Next.js/TypeScript with Sanity CMS and
Storybook, extending the design system to cut duplicate code and keep the experience polished.

Built React/TypeScript interfaces and Prisma-backed Node/Express services for secure HR case workflows, adding dynamic staff routing, hardened permissions, and automated ESLint/Prettier + unit-test checks.

Contributed to a one-of-a-kind, mobile-first interactive marketing demo for a Fortune 500 progressive web app, handling localized feature work with remote teams and tuning performance for fast global launches.
Technologies: React, Next.js, Electron, TypeScript, SCSS, Node.js/Express, Prisma ORM, Sanity CMS, Storybook,
GSAP, Cypress, Jest, React Testing Library, GitHub Actions, ESLint, Prettier, localization & accessibility tools.
Software Engineer (Contract) | PartsTrader Markets Ltd. | Wellington, NZ
Developed a dedicated .NET microservice to interface with a legacy API and built a modern, responsive front-end using React withTypeScript.
Translated Figma UI designs into dynamic, accessible interfaces using React, TypeScript, and styled-components.
Applied Domain-Driven Design principles by structuring the microservice with Repository, Domain Model,
Mapper, and Application Service patterns.
Technologies: .NET service layer, React, TypeScript, Cypress, GitHub Actions, domain-driven design patterns.
Software Engineer & Founder | Habitual Genesis | Remote
2016 – Present
Partner with authors, museums, and education nonprofits to ship low-maintenance digital products.
Delivered discovery-through-launch engagements while keeping ongoing costs low.
Stayed lean by embedding with stakeholders to clarify needs, prioritise MVPs, and trial marketing ideas without raising spend.
Various projects with General Assembly, Thinkful, Codecademy, and others
Technologies: JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, GitHub, GitHub Pages, Squarespace, Mailchimp, Google Drive.
Software Engineer & Lead Instructor | The Flatiron School | Remote
Delivered remote & asynchronous technical training on software engineering to a diverse group of students.
Wrote and presented curriculum covering JavaScript, HTML/CSS, ReactJS, Python, Flask, PostgreSQL,
Object-Oriented Programming, CI/CD, Agile, APIs, Web Accessibility, and more.
Mentored and coached junior engineers, preparing them for success in their roles and job duties.
Lead a working group promoting inclusive web design and web accessibility practices.
Technologies: JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, ReactJS, React Router, Python, Flask, Object-Oriented Programming,
CI/CD, Render.com, Agile, APIs, Web Accessibility
Senior Software Engineer | WorkTango (formerly KazooHR) | Remote
Re-architected the Rewards platform from Rails to ReactJS, resulting in a 15% increase in customer engagement.
Implemented a modular design system to improve UI consistency and boost developer velocity.
Integrated features across Performance Management and Rewards platforms to overhaul the product suite.
Technologies: ReactJS, Storybook, NodeJS, Jest, Chai, TypeScript, Ruby on Rails, ActiveRecord, RSpec, GraphQL,
PostgreSQL, Circle CI, SASS/SCSS, GitHub, Design Language Systems, JIRA, Zeplin, Figma.
Software Engineer | Condé Nast | Austin, TX
Delivered new design features & ReactJS components for over 26 media brands, improving readership and SEO.

Built and iterated upon a brand-agnostic paywall architecture and a suite of components, driving significant growth and achieving a year-over-year increase of over 100% in monthly subscriptions for Vanity Fair and Wired.
Authored a technology blog post on End-to-End Testing of the Condé Nast Paywalls.
https://technology.condenast.com/story/end-to-end-testing-conde-nast-paywalls
Technologies: ReactJS, Storybook, NodeJS, Jest, Puppeteer, TypeScript, SASS, GitHub, Jenkins, CI/CD, Design
Language Systems, JIRA.
Software Engineer & Instructor | Hack Reactor (formerly Galvanize) | Austin, TX
Facilitated technical workshops for full-time and part-time programs in an Agile environment.
Built a mock interview app for students, exponentially increasing career services' capacity to give feedback.
Technologies: ReactJS, JavaScript, jQuery, Mocha, Chai, HTML, CSS3, SASS/SCSS, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Git,
GitHub, Heroku, bash, zsh.
Software Engineer (Contract) | Bypass Mobile | Austin, TX
Designed and developed a JSON-API spec product licensing platform using Ruby on Rails as part of a small team.
Technologies: JSON-API, Ruby on Rails, ActiveRecord, RSpec, MySQL, Git, GitHub, Vagrant, bash, JIRA.
Software Engineer | Union Metrics | Austin, TX
Migrated and refactored two legacy codebases to use Rails 4, improving maintainability, security of core business features, and performance by 20%.
Created a knowledge base of 100 most common customer technical challenges, reducing resolution time by 50%.
Technologies: JavaScript, Ruby on Rails, ActiveRecord, RSpec, jQuery, HTML, CSS3, SASS/SCSS, MySQL, Git, GitHub,
Vagrant, Jenkins, bash.
Postgraduate Diploma in Information Technology | Whitireia and WelTec, New Zealand
Full-Stack Web Development, Ruby on Rails, and JavaScript Certification | Dev Bootcamp
BS in Business Administration, Entrepreneurship, & International Business | Chapman University
